entries.text: 修复 SATTC 推荐重复条件的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed SATTC recommending duplicate conditions

entries.text: 外查询存在分组时也可进行标量子查询解关联
entries.textEn: Scalar-subquery decorrelation also applies when the outer query groups

entries.text: 修复两个相同标量子查询场景的重写算法
entries.textEn: Fixed the rewrite algorithm for two identical scalar subqueries

entries.text: RuleQueryFoldingRewrite 增加第二种算法，避免添加内层选择列
entries.textEn: RuleQueryFoldingRewrite gained a second algorithm that avoids adding inner select columns

entries.text: RuleNotInNullableSubQueryRewrite 使用 NFC 判断是否需要补 is not null
entries.textEn: RuleNotInNullableSubQueryRewrite uses NFC to decide whether to add is not null

entries.text: 不带通配符的 LIKE 查询重写为等值条件
entries.textEn: LIKE without wildcards is rewritten to an equality predicate

entries.text: 修复谓词下推在嵌套变量与 rank 函数场景的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed predicate pushdown with nested variables and rank functions

entries.text: 支持 N'dd' 字符串反序列化
entries.textEn: Added N'dd' string deserialisation

entries.text: 修复常量解析（_UTF8 '-'）的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed constant parsing for _UTF8 '-'

entries.text: 条件可以作为函数参数；聚集函数语法扩展，支持 jsonb_agg
entries.textEn: Conditions are accepted as function parameters; aggregate grammar gained jsonb_agg

entries.text: 新增 SQL 模板与 SQL 混淆功能
entries.textEn: Added SQL templates and SQL obfuscation

entries.text: 修复变量常量 getSQL 的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed getSQL for variable constants

entries.text: 开放 sql-transformer 能力
entries.textEn: Exposed the sql-transformer capability

entries.text: 修复子查询 getSQL 的缺陷
entries.textEn: Fixed getSQL for subqueries

entries.text: 优化 bigserial 数据类型解析（unique、not null、自增）
entries.textEn: Improved bigserial datatype parsing (unique, not null, identity)

entries.text: 修复 WithTable 深拷贝导致的内存泄漏
entries.textEn: Fixed a memory leak from deep-copying WithTable

entries.text: 性能验证支持科学计数法表示的行数
entries.textEn: Performance validation accepts row counts in scientific notation

entries.text: 优化 validateSyntax
entries.textEn: Improved validateSyntax

entries.text: div 可以作为标识符
entries.textEn: div is allowed as an identifier

entries.text: 兼容 u2003 等非标准空白字符
entries.textEn: Added support for non-standard whitespace such as u2003
